rules.description: Caps Lock → Hyper Key (tap alone → Caps Lock)

to.shell_command: [ -n "$(lsappinfo find name='Visual Studio Code')" ] && open -a 'Visual Studio Code.app' || /Users/shay/.local/bin/vscode --new-window

APP_ASN=$(lsappinfo find name='Obsidian'); [ -n "$APP_ASN" ] && WIN_COUNT=$(osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to (count windows of (first process whose name is "Obsidian"))' 2>/dev/null) && [ "${WIN_COUNT:-0}" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null && open -a 'Obsidian.app' || open 'raycast://extensions/marcjulian/obsidian/openVaultCommand'
[ -n "$(lsappinfo find name='Google Chrome')" ] && open -a 'Google Chrome.app' || open -na 'Google Chrome.app'
